answer.rationale: Finance mandates 18% cut to component spend; the low-cost vendor quote meets the mandate alone while the incumbent path would require uncertain negotiation. Memory c2 documents that moving primary supply to this low-cost vendor last year cut unit cost sharply with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, indicating the switch can minimize total cost of ownership without introducing delivery disruption. With the primary contract expiring in 14 days and no auto-renew, and only one decision permitted this cycle, switching primary vendor directly satisfies the cost target and leverages proven past execution.
